full_prompt_en: A square sepia drawing shows two formally dressed people walking together on a broad promenade, surrounded by lightly sketched passersby. The warm paper ground remains visible across the sky and open pavement, giving the scene a spacious, unfinished quality. In the left foreground, a dark-coated man in a short-brimmed hat turns his head toward the woman beside him. His upper body is the densest black mass in the composition, with charcoal strokes describing the coat, trouser legs, and mustached profile. Just to his right, the woman is seen from behind and in partial profile. A small decorated hat sits above dark hair gathered high, and a fitted black bodice narrows into a long, full skirt rendered with flowing graphite-like hatching. Their close shoulders and turned heads suggest conversation as they move away from the viewer. A partial figure cuts into the far left edge, while a pale, indistinct person stands just behind the man. A diagonal railing begins near the central pair and recedes toward the upper right, guiding the eye into a lighter crowd. Farther back, a woman in a pale long dress stands near the railing, and several men in tall hats occupy the right distance. Faint vertical marks and tiny figures suggest a busy waterfront or public walkway without specifying an exact place. The lower right pavement is mostly empty, crossed by a few thin horizontal strokes that establish its flat surface. Illumination is implied by the clean paper tone rather than painted highlights; the foreground silhouettes are dark, while distant figures lose contrast in the haze. Loose contour lines, swift crosshatching, and rubbed charcoal shadows give the clothing weight without filling every region. No readable text appears. The overall composition balances the dark, intimate pair against a wide pale walkway and receding social crowd, creating an observational, fleeting mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色素描呈现两位衣着正式的人一起走在宽阔漫步道上，周围是轻轻勾出的过路人。暖色纸底在天空与开阔路面上保持可见，使场景具有宽敞、未完全填满的气息。左侧前景，一名穿深外套、戴短檐帽的男子将头转向身旁女子。他的上半身是构图中最浓的黑色团块，炭笔般痕迹描出外套、裤腿和带胡须的侧脸。紧挨着他右侧的女子以后背及部分侧面出现。小巧饰帽立于向上挽起的深色头发之上，贴身黑色上衣收窄后接一条长而宽的裙子，裙面由流动的石墨般排线描绘。两人靠近的肩膀和转动的头部暗示他们边走边交谈。一名局部人物切入最左缘，男子后面还有一个浅淡、不清晰的人影。一道斜向栏杆从中央两人附近开始，向右上远处退去，把目光带入更浅的拥挤人群。较远处，一位穿浅色长裙的女子站在栏杆旁，几名戴高帽的男子占据右侧远方。隐约的竖线与细小人影暗示繁忙的滨水区或公共步道，却没有指明具体地点。右下路面大部分空着，几道纤细横线建立其平坦表面。照明由干净的纸色暗示，而非绘出的高光；前景剪影深暗，远处人影在薄雾中失去对比。松散轮廓线、迅速的交叉排线与擦抹出的炭色阴影令衣物具有重量，而无需填满每片区域。画中没有可读文字。整体构图以深暗亲近的两人平衡宽阔浅色步道与逐渐远去的社交人群，营造瞬间观察般的气息。
style_prompt_en: The drawing uses warm tan paper as an active light field, with black and umber charcoal-like marks laid over it in sharply varying density. Close forms collect broad dark strokes and fine crosshatching, while distant forms remain pale, abbreviated outlines. Swift, slightly broken contours define movement and clothing folds without sealing every boundary. Diagonal linear perspective and scattered vertical accents lead through generous unmarked space, so a few dense masses carry the composition. Shadows are rubbed and grainy, and small highlights are simply untouched paper. The value range narrows with distance, making the atmosphere feel hazy despite the economical marks. There is no polished color blending; pressure, overlap, and gaps in the dry line create the texture. The overall effect is immediate and observational, joining elegant tonal restraint with a lively, sketchbook-like rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅素描把暖棕纸面用作主动的受光色域，在其上叠加密度变化鲜明的黑色与深褐色炭笔般痕迹。靠近观者的形体聚集宽阔深色笔触和细密交叉排线，远处形体则保留浅淡、简略的轮廓。迅速而略有断续的边线描出运动与褶皱，却不封闭每一处边界。斜向透视线和散布的竖向重音穿过宽裕未画区域，使少数浓密团块承载构图。阴影带有擦抹感与颗粒感，小小的亮部只是原纸留白。明度范围随距离收窄，让节省的线条仍产生朦胧大气。画中没有抛光般的色彩混合；干线的力度、重叠和间隙形成肌理。整体效果即时而富于观察感，以优雅的调性克制结合生动的速写本节奏。
theme_en: Two formally dressed walkers on a crowded promenade
theme_zh: 拥挤漫步道上两位衣着正式的行人
name: James Abbott McNeill Whistler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
